text: FOF正在迎来前所未有的扩容周期，年内新成立FOF产品超过150只，募集规模近1500亿元，产品数量、发行规模双双刷新年度纪录。从业内最新动向看，当前还有超过30只FOF正在或即将发行，仅10月12日就有12只FOF集中发行。从制度导向看，FOF也迎来制度发展红利，FOF成立门槛或将从2亿元降低至5000万元，还被允许投资ETF联接基金，更好发挥资产配置功能。（上证报）
text_en: FOFs are entering an unprecedented expansion cycle, with more than 150 FOF products newly established during the year, raising nearly 150 billion yuan, with both the number of products and issuance scale setting annual records. Based on the latest trends in the industry, more than 30 FOFs are currently being or about to be issued, with 12 FOFs centrally issued on October 12 alone. From an institutional perspective, FOFs are also benefiting from institutional development dividends: the threshold for establishing a FOF may be lowered from 200 million yuan to 50 million yuan, and they will also be allowed to invest in ETF feeder funds, better leveraging their asset allocation function. (Shanghai Securities News)
